text:
Sarah (Sales): Hey team — Medivis POC just moved forward. CISO asked for: SOC 2 Type II attestation (summary + PDF), a pen-test attestation/letter, and a network diagram. Also asking whether Dedicated pricing changes if they request single-tenant isolation and extended log retention. Can someone own assembling the evidence pack? @Alex any blockers on staging creds?
Alex (Solutions Eng): I can own the pack. Quick Q: do they want the full SOC 2 control matrix or just the attestation and a 1-page summary? That changes effort. Pricing-wise, single-tenant + 90d log retention bumps price — estimate ~15% delta but need finance confirmation.
Mike (Customer Success): I'll fetch the SOC 2 bundle from Proofpack and grab the attestation PDF. Where should I upload — sftp presigned link or a dataroom? I can also redact repo paths if needed.
Jamie (Security): We have a pen-test attestation template (third-party signed) that we can provide immediately if they accept a past-engagement letter + vuln-scan summary. If they insist on a fresh pentest, that'll add time. Legal needs to review before signing.
Eva (Docs): I can produce a one-page "Evidence Index" with direct links (SOC2 snapshot, ISO excerpts, KMS diagram, network diagram) and a short guide: what each doc covers and contact for follow-ups. Where do we want public vs presigned private access?
Sarah (Sales): They want evidence by EOW (Friday). Can we hit that? I'll push that deadline but want to be realistic.
Alex (Solutions Eng): If Mike uploads the SOC2 PDF now and Jamie approves the pen-test attestation template, I can assemble the bundle and scrub anything PII. Need staging creds only if they want us to run a quick smoke test — otherwise not required.
Mike (Customer Success): Uploading SOC2_Attestation_Medivis_snapshot.pdf to sftp://presigned.medivis/poc_evidence/ now. Added README.txt with a note on redactions.
Jamie (Security): I'll draft the pen-test attestation (template) and drop it in the same folder. Note: attestation will state date of last pentest + summary of findings. If they ask for a signed letter, Legal needs to loop in.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Pricing note for Sales: Dedicated single-tenant + 90d retention is estimated +15% list. If they want guaranteed SLA for throughput during POC, that's a separate commit. I'll flag to pricing.
Sarah (Sales): Ok — I'll tell Medivis we can deliver a consolidated evidence pack by Friday EOD that includes SOC2 snapshot, pen-test attestation template (pending legal sign), and network diagram; single-tenant pricing impact is preliminary +15%. Asking them to confirm whether a signed pentest letter is a deal breaker.
Eva (Docs): I'll create the Evidence Index and an access README in the folder. Will include a quick nav & contact list.
Mike (Customer Success): Done — SOC2 upload complete. ping @Alex @Jamie to confirm files look ok. :thumbsup: 
Jamie (Security): Reviewed the SOC2 snapshot — looks good. Dropping pen-test_attestation_template.pdf now. Legal loop needed for signature; tagging legal via email.
Sarah (Sales): Thanks all — I'll update Medivis and attach the presigned link. If legal needs anything urgent, I'll escalate. Closing this thread once they ack receipt. :white_check_mark:
